title: The Whole Garden
author: Jude Amberdale
blurb: Silas Ravensworth, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
